summary: Tested the Agenda calendar feature (backend appointments list/create/patch/delete, plus the fix so RGPD erase keeps consumed minutes) and the /app/agenda calendar UI (week/day/month views, create by clicking a slot, edit, drag-and-drop move, conflict revert, cancel, open lead, Horario tab save). Backend pytest: 14/14 passed. All requested frontend flows work end to end in the UI.

minor.issue: Past start times are accepted, and so are times outside the configured availability hours. The UI also lets users create an appointment by clicking a past slot. This may be intended for manual bookings; consider at least a warning.

The detail dialog always sends duration_minutes (defaulting to the slot length) even when unchanged, so agent-booked appointments with a null duration get the slot length written on any notes edit. Harmless.

issues: The week view squeezes 7 columns into about 40px each. Event names are fully truncated and only an icon shows. Suggest defaulting to the Día view on small screens.

design_issues.screen: Lead sheet opened from an appointment
issues: The LeadDetail sheet is dark-themed on top of the light dashboard. This is existing styling, but the contrast with the new light calendar is noticeable.

action_items: Optional: default to the day view on mobile widths
Optional: block or warn when creating or moving appointments into past slots
critical_code_review_comments: The unique index on (tenant_id, start) only prevents exact start collisions. Overlapping appointments with different starts (e.g. 10:00 for 60 min and 10:30) are allowed and render on top of each other in TimeGrid, which has no overlap layout.
AgendaCalendar.load swallows errors (catch(() => {})), so a failed fetch shows an empty calendar with no error state.
Drop position uses e.clientY relative to the column, so the event snaps to the slot under the cursor rather than keeping the offset where it was grabbed. Small UX detail.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Test appointments (TEST_iter25*), test leads and usage_archive rows were cleaned up. A concurrent session (not this tester) had PATCHed the sample Carlos Ruiz appointment from 2026-10-16T10:30 to 2026-10-15T10:00 during testing; it was restored to 2026-10-16T10:30.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Container date is 2026-10-15 (Thu) and the browser runs in UTC. The admin's availability is Mon-Fri 09:00-14:00 with 30-min slots, so the time grid shows hours 08-15. Verified: week columns cal-col-*, today highlighted, cal-now-line, hatched off-hours, prev/next/today, month grid with 42 cells, month cell click opens day view, slot-click create with prefilled start, green manual event, detail edit (duration/notes), drag via page.drag_and_drop shows the toast 'Cita movida a las 13:00', a conflicting drop reverts with the toast 'Ya hay una cita a esa hora', cancel confirm, appt-open-lead opens the LeadDetail sheet, and the Horario save shows the toast 'Horario guardado'. Backend tests use far-future dates (2031-03) to avoid collisions.
